rules.gold_scale: Fixed frozen Hellscream cohort anchors or qualified completed sales.
rules.reagent_floor_role: Exact audited 3.3.5 recipe cost is a separate craftability diagnostic and does not automatically set market value.
rules.ammo_price_basis: Ammo guide prices, external comparisons, completed-sale unit prices, and recipe floors are normalized to the displayed stack of 200.
rules.sparse_sale_rule: Low-confidence completed sales receive 25% weight, or 50% when they span at least two buyers and two UTC days; the balance remains the reviewed cohort fallback.
rules.stackable_medium_gate: At least 20 units across four completed buyouts, two distinct buyers, and two distinct UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.one_at_a_time_medium_gate: At least four completed buyouts, two distinct buyers, and two distinct UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
